description: Creates their order page for this product, quantity and model(s): the only way to order. They check and pay on that page; nothing is ordered or charged before. For when they have said yes.

country.description: The delivery country (two letters), if they named one; otherwise their account’s country.

model.description: The size, color or model, in the product page’s words (optional).

product.description: The product reference returned by Rabbit (starts with “p”).

split.description: Several models in one order (“30 in blue, 20 in red”): one line per model; replaces quantity and model.

name: order
title: Order
